## queue-replay-incremental: queue state replays only newly appended entries per queue session

- `local` (Ops #701; the owner via COO rm-c05aad8c, chat-open speed fix 6; plan approved in Ops lead). Hypothesis (H-QUEUE-REPLAY): in #689's 30 s profiles `server/task-queue.ts` `replayState` took 4.7% and `pi-queue` `replay` took 4.4% of the main thread (combined 9.09% mean) because unchanged queue entries were replayed from scratch on each read or event (`roles-overview` `scanQueue`, `queueEntriesOf` callers in `agent-service`, `taskQueueOfConv`, and `pi-queue` `branchState`). Keeping the replayed state per queue session and applying only newly appended entries (falling back to a full replay on any non-append) should cut the combined share below 1%; wrong if it remains above 3%. Record: ~/kept-from-tmp/2026-10-31/chat-open-time/fixes/queue-replay/RESULT.md.
- `server/task-queue.ts` `replayState(entries, queueId)` (paired with `pi-queue` `queue-ops.ts` `replay(entries, queueId)`): caches the prefix references and replayed `State` in WeakMaps keyed on the entries array (in-place append callers: `readQueueEntries`, `roles-overview` `s.queue`) and on the root entry object (fresh-slice callers: `SessionManager.getBranch()`), scoped by `queueId` and active `piQueueReaders()?.replay`. On a pure append (`entries.length >= prefix.length` and reference equality across `prefix`), applies only `entries[prefix.length .. entries.length - 1]` (or skips replay/projection altogether when no new `"queue"` custom entry was appended) and returns a deep clone preserving non-enumerable `from.id`. On any non-append (branch switch, compaction, truncation or replaced entry), falls back to a full replay from `emptyReplayState`.
- Checks: `tests/unit/task-queue.test.ts` ("H-QUEUE-REPLAY: incremental replayState", run both against `apply()` and via `tests/unit/task-queue-canonical.test.ts` against `pi-queue`'s `readers.replay`), plus `pi-queue` `tests/queue.test.ts` and `tests/transcript-tail.test.ts`: incremental equals full across in-place appends and `getBranch()` slices, each entry's `.data` is read once (fails on the old code where entry 0 is read N times), non-enumerable `from.id` is preserved, and branch switches, compaction, truncation and in-place replacement fall back to a full replay.
- Undo: revert this commit and `pi-web-deploy` it (and revert `pi-queue`'s companion commit + `pi-web-deploy restart`).
